title: 5.4 Likes and Dislikes
unit_outcome: Express simple food preferences and needs and complete a supported purchase or café order.
goal: Understand and express first-person food preferences with I like and I do not like.
grammar_function: Affirmative I like + food and negative I do not like + food; do not is taught as a complete beginner chunk.
prerequisite: 3.2 I, You, and We; Unit 1 not; 5.1-5.3 foods and quantities.
speaking_outcome: Say three affirmative and three negative preference sentences using I.

cards.pedagogy_note: New positive pattern; explicit teaching, not inferred assessment.
Exact positive/negative contrast with same subject and food.
Negative cue is visible and unique.
Both are visibly negative; food decides.
Review number and color; every feature decisive.
Review two foods; no image support.
Do not must be present for semantic completeness.
Links familiar not to do not chunk.

options.label: I do not like three oranges.

cards.pedagogy_note: Purposeful review of number, fruit, and preference without introducing a new question form.
